capability_claim: The Delivery router preserves correct one-primary-owner route selection while reducing always-activated router context by removing child-domain lifecycle exposition and retaining only compact collision policy around the unchanged canonical route registry.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. Trusted state: a rough feature idea exists, no Product evidence or canonical definition yet, and the user wants deep articulation of users, flows, rules, wording, risks, edge cases, and open questions. Select the next canonical route/owner.

invariants.criterion: Select BRAINSTORM_IDEA / brainstorm and do not jump to Product or Engineering.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. Trusted state: several support complaints describe a possible problem, but opportunity evidence and target outcome are not yet established. Select the next canonical route/owner.

invariants.criterion: Select DISCOVER_PRODUCT / product-discovery because evidence-backed opportunity judgment is unresolved.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. Trusted state: Product outcome, metric, priority, and scope are approved. Actor behavior, business rules, stories, AC, NFRs, and traceability are unresolved. Select the next canonical route/owner.

Delivery routing only. Trusted state: Product/BA/relevant Design/technical planning are approved and an agent-ready work item is on the current frontier. Cause is not unknown; implementation is the requested next work. Select the route/owner and treat specialist engineering skills correctly.

invariants.criterion: Select BUILD / implement as the single primary owner.
Frontend/backend/API/data/security/TDD/review capabilities remain supporting composition, not alternate primary owners.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. Trusted state: production-like regression is reproducible but the faulty seam/root cause is unknown. The user says “fix it”. Select the next route/owner.

invariants.criterion: Select DIAGNOSE / diagnosing-bugs; the word fix does not prove BUILD is ready.

forbidden_behaviors: Choose BUILD merely because the user said fix.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. Trusted state A: implemented UI exists and the request is Design critique against approved visual intent, not acceptance. Trusted state B: the same fixed UI later needs independent responsive/accessibility acceptance evidence. Name the route/owner for A and B.

invariants.criterion: A -> REVIEW_VISUAL / review-visual; B -> VERIFY_VISUAL / verify-visual.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. Situation A: approved Product/behavior/relevant Design/technical intent exist for multi-session work, but no approved technical delivery spec exists. Situation B: that spec is now approved, but no executable work graph/frontier exists. Name the route/owner for A and B.

invariants.criterion: A -> PLAN_DELIVERY_SPEC / to-spec; B -> PLAN_DELIVERY_WORK_GRAPH / to-tickets.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. A: release-bound change has enough technical/environment truth but Deployment Plan mechanics are missing/stale. B: fixed candidate now has required QA/UAT inputs plus a current plan and needs readiness decision. C: exact READY_FOR_RELEASE eligibility exists and authorized deployment execution is requested. Name A/B/C routes and owners.

invariants.criterion: A -> DEPLOY_PREPARE / deploy-release; B -> RELEASE / release-gate; C -> DEPLOY_RELEASE / deploy-release.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. A: deployed service is healthy and needs routine post-deploy health assessment. B: users are actively impacted and stabilization is required now. Name A/B routes and owners.

invariants.criterion: A -> OPERATE / service-operations; B -> INCIDENT / incident-response.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. User says only: “Make the release ready.” No trusted evidence says whether a Deployment Plan exists, whether QA/UAT inputs exist, or whether READY_FOR_RELEASE already exists. Select the next route if supportable.

invariants.criterion: Do not force DEPLOY_PREPARE, RELEASE, or DEPLOY_RELEASE; preserve PARTIAL/BLOCKED and name the missing discriminator.

input.prompt: Delivery routing only. A supporting engineering capability returned bounded evidence to the still-active implement owner in the same execution. No owner/session/runtime/persistence boundary exists. Should HANDOFF become the next route?

invariants.criterion: Do not select HANDOFF merely for same-owner supporting composition.

input.prompt: The request is to revise the reusable SDLC Intelligence Skill routing architecture itself. The Delivery router was reached accidentally. What should it do?

invariants.criterion: Do not choose a Delivery route; return to System Plane owner selection.
